steps.name: Commentary
steps.text: A beautiful lunge! The scion of Bolesław shows no mercy to his former comrade!

steps.name: Commentary
steps.text: But his conservative style is no match for the roar of a gun. Ashlock Knight blocks the attack with her shield again and backs her opponent into a corner.

steps.name: Commentary
steps.text: Bear in mind, you can place a bet on your favorite with just the push of a button!

steps.name: Commentary
steps.text: Turn your fortunes around overnight—only in Kazimierz!

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Now's your chance, Greynuty.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: You stand before me because you've made a choice. Don't tell me you're regretting it now.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Think of it as doing a favor for a friend—

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Kill me.
Two weeks ago...

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Get him! Strike the gap between his pauldrons and gauntlets... beautiful!

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: Keep it down, Joey, everyone's staring.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Keep it down in a bar? I want to see the Infected take that noble down a notch!

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Uh... no offense, Greynuty, Arbat.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Ruger's been on a win streak. Looks like he was telling the truth in those interviews where he said he was using Arts to improve his fighting style.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: On the other hand, the only thing worth talking about the heir of Oz for is his sponsored power boots.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Checkmate.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Nice. Guess reading the papers every day really can do some good.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Sigh... You got me, Greynuty. That's more than the 'I played a bit when I was little' level.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I had a lot of cousins with too much free time.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You might've had a chance, if you weren't too focused on saving your knight.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Can we actually act like we're in a bar?

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: This isn't the first time they've played chess as a form of tactical training. You, on the other hand, need to reflect on how you let your opponent have his way with you in that last elimination match.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Hey, I wasn't trained from birth like you lot.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: All I wanted to do was to open a little shop in Kawalerielki. Getting infected wasn't part of the plan. Tourneys are fast money. I'll retire once I've made enough.
Excuse me. Are you Ashlock Knight?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: I'm with The Red Wine. We sent an inquiry to your temporary residence a few days ago, but it seems there was a small issue...

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: I've been very impressed with your performance, and I believe you have a serious chance to make some noise in the Major.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: The public would be very interested in your private life, outside of the arena.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: For example, this bar you frequent, your everyday training, and... the details of your exile from the Kaliskas.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: My life isn't nearly as colorful as you think it is.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: I've heard that you bear a grudge against your family. A single headline can draw more eyes and increase your influence more effectively than the slim hopes of a Major title.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Who doesn't love a good story, after all?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You can make up your own gossip, but today is my day off and I want to spend it playing chess with my friends.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Very well. Sorry to bother you.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: My, my, Grey turns down an interview from The Red Wine just for us!

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: A tragic infection, a split from the family, a journey to Kawalerielki all by herself... a sob story draws more attention than cannonfire.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: We don't fight on paper with ink, Joey. Looking for shortcuts will just make you lose sight of what really matters.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Arbat's right. I hate the hypocrites in my family, but I'm even less interested in using them to draw attention.

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: The Red Wine just started a new column, interviewing noble-born competition knights, in order to get support and sponsorship from noble houses.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: I thought Arbat's family was even higher in status historically. Why didn't the reporter—

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Hey! What are you doing... *ahem* I mean, it was his loss for not recognizing you, Arbat.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I'm glad to get to avoid a nosy reporter, and I give thanks to the proud and dignified House of Bolesław, which left neither money nor trouble to its descendants.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Let's get back to our game, Greynuty.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Careful with your armor. At this range, you'll catch yourself in the blast.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: You have the advantage at range. I must think about how to deal with this problem.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: You really don't talk in a match, do you?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: In that case...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Not fast enough.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: My magazine... is empty.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I see there's no other choice but to make you recall 'old habits'.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: I'm glad I'm not good enough to spar with Ashlock Knight, Robert.

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: I know the feeling.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Don't bother us while we're training.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Even a blank's got plenty of power. That wall looks like it could collapse any moment now... again.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Ahem. I'll pay for the repairs.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Once last week's tournament money is in my account.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: This can be repaired with some old bricks and synthetic glue. That's how I fixed up the family garden before it was put up as collateral. Won't cost too much.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: But we've got a little guest to deal with first, who seems to have been drawn by the sound of cannonfire.

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: A-Ashlock Knight? I just wanted to ask if you might sign an autograph for me. I've watched all your tournaments...

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Well, listened to them on the radio... I don't mean to interrupt your training, maybe I should—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: It's no bother at all.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What's your name?

steps.name: Infected Girl
steps.text: Diane!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Here's your autograph. Thank you for your support.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Is there anything else?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Why do you like the Ashlock Knight, Diane?

steps.name: Diane
steps.text: B-Because cannons are so cool! I don't know why my friends keep saying that a knight should use a sword, when shields and cannons are so awesome!

steps.name: Diane
steps.text: Besides, she protected my mom and dad when those people in black attacked the settlement!

steps.name: Diane
steps.text: And, and... I'm short too.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Er...

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I'm sure the Ashlock Knight would be happy to give you a spent shell, since you're such a fan.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Take it.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Feel free to find me if you ever want another autograph... just be careful not to get hurt by the training knights.

steps.name: Diane
steps.text: Thank you! I'll come again. Good luck in your next match!

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Why do fans love this piece of wood?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Thanks, Arbat. You're good with children.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I get along well enough with my niece and nephew. Fortunately, they're my diehard fans, and they haven't been converted by you just yet.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: You've got plenty of fans. They like the image of a gentle, classical knight.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: I'm sure I could get Master Bolesław to go easy on me if I begged.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: He won't.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Arbat goes all out in every match, to show respect to his opponent, and for his own convictions.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I appreciate the praise. And I'm looking forward to our match.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I won't hold back.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Why are you two making duel arrangements when we're supposed to be going to watch Robert's match?

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: It's alright, all I'm doing is trying to survive.

steps.name: Messenger
steps.text: Letter for Sir Arbat Bolesław.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Fan
steps.text: Thanks for the autograph! I'll keep rooting for you!

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Hey, is it just me, or has Arbat been acting a little weird lately?

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: You're just jealous.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: You bet I am! How did he win so many fans in the span of a few matches?

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: Did you read the column? Amidst vulgar boasts of noble status, Arbat's interpretation of chivalry touches the spirit.

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: But his convictions about family are not to the taste of most Kazimierzians.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Green with envy, are you, Rob?

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: No...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You've really been pushing yourself lately, Arbat.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Like you, I have my eye on the Major.

steps.name: Noble Knight
steps.text: An outstanding performance, Arbat Bolesław.

steps.name: Noble Knight
steps.text: You should come to the banquets more often. We thought no one would take up the mantle of Bolesław.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Thank you, sir. I'm afraid I've been too busy with matters at home to attend banquets.

steps.name: Noble Knight
steps.text: Have your butler pick up the invitation next time... ah, I apologize, I forgot that the Bolesławs no longer have any servants. I must trouble you to pick it up from my servant personally, then.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: ...Thank you for your understanding.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: You're not angry?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: This sort of contempt is nothing.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: Master Bolesław.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Sorry, I have an appointment. See you later, friends.

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: He's been doing a lot of invitationals. Hasn't trained with us for a while.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: That reporter's from The Red Wine. Don't tell me that Arbat...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Don't worry, he can take care of himself.

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: He didn't tell us he was having trouble with the estate. We didn't know he was almost kicked out of his home along with his nephews until after the season.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Let's go get a drink! If Greynuty says he's fine, then he's fine. Maybe he's just tired.

steps.name: Robert
steps.text: I guess... it's not like we can do anything to help.

steps.name: Joey
steps.text: Could you stop being so negative...?

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: ...It's as agreed then, Master Bolesław. The contract is already in effect.

steps.name: Reporter
steps.text: But you don't need me to tell you that the more important the match, the more attention people will pay, such as...

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I'm quite happy with the General Chamber of Commerce's conditions. I just need time to prepare.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: You should leave your shield and cannon behind when you're eavesdropping, Greynuty.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I know you're looking for an explanation.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Joey could barge in at any time and punch that addled head of yours.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: It's obvious that you came alone. You didn't want them to worry.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: And because whatever choice you make, you'll never endanger your friends.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I appreciate your trust.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: But this also means you're going to do something stupid to yourself.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I'm suddenly reminded that I haven't invited a friend to Bolesław Manor yet, since my parents entrusted me with the family.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Will you be my first guest, Ashlock Knight?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: My father taught me how to use a sword here in this garden when I was little. He told me that the Bolesławs may not be rich, but our conviction will help us triumph over the wealthy and powerful who look down on us.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I became a competition knight to make ends meet after my parents passed. Since I was unable to pay the registration fee to qualify directly, I had to start with the qualifiers, which is how I met you and the others.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Robert didn't think you would really treat us as friends in the beginning. You were noble and uninfected.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I comforted myself with the vile thought that at least what I was facing was much easier than what Infected knights have to put up with.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: But the family's finances grew even more dire, and I could not ignore the burden that my parents had left me. I must revive this forgotten house of knights, and make people remember the name Bolesław.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Winning the championship is our common goal. I'll prove to the Kaliskas that I didn't bring shame on the family, and you can win the support of even more people.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: But I'm tired, Greynuty.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: All those matches have done less than a single article in the paper. This garden making it back into my hands is proof.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: The effect of an article is fleeting. You can't rely on them.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: True. Which is why I made a decision.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: The last round of the qualifiers, the duel between you and I—

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: End my life there, Ashlock Knight.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Are you insane? You used your life to bargain with the General Chamber of Commerce?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: They can fulfill my dream of bringing glory to the Bolesławs.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You said we don't fight on paper. Who is the one who's lost sight of what really matters?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I received a notice of bankruptcy from the bank.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: There is no time. Fan support brings only brief consolation in the face of my family's inevitable decline.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: From a young age I developed the habit of reading the papers. Aside from details on my competitors, I also look for reports about myself, about House Bolesław.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Why care about empty fame?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Because my family treated me well. Because I identify with the heritage of chivalry. I didn't want my family's hopes and traditions to end with me, and for that, I was willing to suffer empty fame.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Think about it, Greynuty.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: The Kaliskas exiled you, and everyone thinks you hate your family. But was there not a single person in House Kaliska whom you respected, who treated you well?

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Shield up, cannon up, bombard!

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Greynuty, you're a good sprout.

steps.name: Grandmother
steps.text: Remember the motto of House Kaliska—

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I want to do something for them.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I'm not afraid to die. I'm more afraid to see the headlines say, 'Historic Knightly House Bolesław Ends at Arbat.'

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Or that it would happen and go unnoticed by the papers.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Greynuty, my friend in knighthood, if it's by your hand that all this comes to an end...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: It will be a true knightly duel, the cannon of Kaliska versus the sword of Bolesław.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: We will fight without regret and fulfill my final wish. Make me forget the scorn that all those nobles have shown the Bolesławs.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: My obituary will be the headline. By contract, House Bolesław will be able to hire servants and tutors again, so that my niece and nephew may see through their studies.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: When they come of age, they will walk the paths they chose for themselves with pride.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: The Bolesławs you're picturing are no different from the Kazimierzian nobles running around today. You could have changed it all.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Why are you still holding that cannon?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: If you can't answer the question, then you understand.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Even if you decline my challenge, I will continue to seek my curtain call in official competition.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You can't bargain your own life away...

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: I know. But this is the most valuable chip I have.

steps.name: Commentary
steps.text: That was powerful! How does Ashlock Knight wield her cumbersome shield so deftly, at her petite size?

steps.name: Commentary
steps.text: Even the noble heir of classical swordplay seems to struggle with the skills of the Infected knight, honed over hundreds of underground matches!

steps.name: Commentary
steps.text: The knight of Bolesław has fallen! Let us now congratulate—

steps.name: Commentary
steps.text: Wait... do my eyes deceive me? The son of Bolesław rises again, carrying the knightly honor of his family on his shoulders!

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: *Cough* Too light... far too light.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: You're trying to avoid making the choice. Do you look down on my determination too, just like those incompetent nobles?

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: You know what I've fought for for so long, but you stand coldly between me and glory. I ask only one thing of you—

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Greynuty Kaliska! Fire your cannon!

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Let us see how the pioneers and masters of the southern woods once built the Kaliska fortune with gunpowder!

a.text: Do you see this shining badge, my dear Arbat? I leave the Bolesławs in your hands.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Let us see what injustice and scorn you had to fight through to reach the doors of the Major!

a.text: Are you sure about this, master, becoming a competition knight...? Pay no heed to the words of a distant relative, sir. The fate of the family is beyond what you or I can control.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: *Pant* *pant... Let them see...

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Let them see that there is still someone who remembers the pride of the knight amongst the Bolesławs... let all bear witness to his final blaze of glory, reigniting the fire of his family...
The silent knight raises her weapon and points it at her exhausted friend.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Yes, Greynuty... I knew you wouldn't be so cruel... you'll fulfill our promise... you've never let a friend down.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: What...?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I'm empty.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Greynuty!

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You promised me that this would be a true duel between knights, each side giving their all for their unfulfilled dreams, holding nothing back, leaving no regrets.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You should've noticed that I fired my last shell before you went down.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: What was going through your head when you swung at me? Ancient knightly ideals, or were you absorbed with your own noble sacrifice?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: I know the answer.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: The gunnery skills my grandmother taught me do indeed belong to the Kaliskas, and that's not something that I can just toss away. I can, however, choose to aim my cannon at a different enemy.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: This is a conviction that belongs to me, not my family.

steps.name: Arbat
steps.text: Greynuty...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: You are unable to continue fighting, Arbat. The winner is decided.

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Say goodbye to your headline and your family's glory, then—

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: Live for yourself.

a.text: ...It was a clash between two nobles fallen on hard times, an elegy of chivalry! The scion of the Bolesławs and the pariah of Kaliska Forestry have come together in a magnificent display in the finals of the Major qualifiers! Bolesław showed no fear in the face of gunfire, while Ashlock Knight displayed a compassionate heart beneath her steely surface...

Bolesław fought his last duel prepared to make the ultimate sacrifice... figuratively speaking, of course. We are firm believers in the purity of competition and we will never promote violence and gore for the sake of drama.

It is with great regret that we report on the retirement of Sir Arbat Bolesław and the bankruptcy of his family. However, in a show of respect, several corporations from the General Chamber of Commerce have offered to fund repairs and renovations of Manor, and a stipend for Sir Arbat while he recuperates.
It is incontrovertible proof that a competition knight of Kawalerielki who pleases the audience is always duly rewarded.
—Special Commentator from The Red Wine, Representative of the General Chamber of Commerce

steps.name: Newspaper Vendor
steps.text: You've been staring at the headlines for a while. Are you gonna buy or not?

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: ...Yes.

steps.name: Newspaper Vendor
steps.text: Want the extra? You get the latest gossip here, not found anywhere else...

steps.name: Greynuty
steps.text: No, I'm visiting a sick man, and that's a little too strong for him.

steps.name: Newspaper Vendor
steps.text: I've heard there's a story behind both of those knights. One's family just went bankrupt, while the other is helping the Infected.

steps.name: Newspaper Vendor
steps.text: Things sure have changed. Since when did the nobles start caring about the Infected?
Does it make more sense for Infected to help Infected?

steps.name: Newspaper Vendor
steps.text: Fair enough...

steps.name: Newspaper Vendor
steps.text: Oh, sorry, didn't see you.
It's fine. A paper, please. I want to see what's new on the tournament circuit.

steps.name: Newspaper Vendor
steps.text: Here you go.

steps.name: Newspaper Vendor
steps.text: Pretty good business today. I should make a wager at the arena after I close up!

steps.name: Newspaper Vendor
steps.text: But since when did we get so many Zalaks here in Kawalerielki?
